text.p: THURSDAY, MARCH 6
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Telecoms Council (1000/0900 GMT).
Agenda includes:

- Proposal for an EP and Council directive on the application of open network provision (ONP) to voice telephony and on universal service for telecommunications in a competitive environment (replacing EP and Council directive 95/62/EC).
- Co-decision procedures with the EP.
- Commission report on the Universal Mobile Telecommunications Systems technology.
- Application of member state legislation in the telecoms sector.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer meets British Foreign Shadow Minister Robin Cook.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Flynn holds news conference on equal rights between men and women for the international women's day (1200/1100 GMT).

BRUSSELS - Conference Board Europe and American Electronics Association Europe hold joint conference on "The information society and electronic commerce". Venue: Conrad Hotel. Contact: Stephanie Holmgren, AEA Europe (322) 502 6734.

LOUVAIN-LA-NEUVE, Belgium (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer addresses European Studies Institute on "Values and references for European construction" (2015/1915 GMT). Venue: Auditoire Socrate, Place Cardinal Mercier. Contact: European Studies Institute (3210) 47 85 45.

PARIS - CICERO Foundation holds conference on "Results of the IGC - preparing the Amsterdam treaty". Agenda includes: the issue of flexibility - will Britain block "Core Europe"?; is the Dutch presidency preparing a special strategy?; reforming the Common Foreign and Security Policy - the chances for a Mr CFSP; a breakthrough in the third pillar (justice and home affairs); institutional arrangements - power struggle or compromise?; the IGC seen from Central and Eastern Europe. Contact: CICERO Foundation (33) 1 42 67 9204.
WARSAW - CER, UIC and UNIFE hold joint conference on "The pan-European dimension of rail transport" (0900/0800 GMT). Contact: Rita Moosen, CER (322) 525 9079.

WELS-UPPER, Austria - Energiesparverband, in cooperation with the European Commission, holds conference on "World energy efficiency day" (0800/0700 GMT). Discussions focus on energy efficiency-the gateway to our future; local and regional strategies for energy efficiency; energy efficiency in industry. Venue: City Hall. Contact: Energiesparverband (43) 732 6584 4380.
FRIDAY, MARCH 7

BRUSSELS (MODIFIED ITEM) - U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen meets NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana, NATO Military Committee Chairman General Klaus Naumann; attends roundtable of NATO ambassadors. (1645/1545).
BRUSSELS - European Commission hosts conference on priority actions for completion of the single market.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EP and Council Conciliation Committee meets to discuss decision on a series of guidelines for trans-European telecoms networks. Commissioner Bangemann attends.

BRUSSELS - European disability forum - founding general assembly (0900/0800 GMT) (and Saturday). Speakers include: MEPs Barbara Schmidbauer, Richard Howitt, Bartho Pronk. Venue: Vlaams Europees Conferentie Centrum, 1-3 rue du Marquis.
SATURDAY, MARCH 8
LUXEMBOURG - Forex Luxembourg celebrates its 40th anniversary. European Commission President Santer and Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker attend.
SUNDAY, MARCH 9

GENEVA (NEW ITEM) - EP Intergroup Tibet, Radical Party, European Tibet Support Group, Tibetan Communities in Europe hold second European demonstration for the freedom of Tibet (1300/1200 GMT) (To March 10). Speakers include: European Commissioner Bonino and MEP James Moorhouse. Venue: In front of the U.N. building. Contact: Geneve 1997 (41) 22 740 4544.
